description: CP Gantt Chart is a professional Power BI custom visual designed for clear, flexible, and highly interactive visualization of project timelines, tasks, durations, dependencies, and progress. It brings full project planning capabilities directly into Power BI—no external tools required. Key Capabilities: Interactive Gantt chart showing tasks, start/end dates, durations, milestones, and progress. Task hierarchy support including groups, parent tasks, and detailed subtasks. Flexible formatting with customizable colors, labels, styles, and conditional formatting. Optimized performance allowing smooth work with large datasets and complex project structures. Fully integrated with Power BI including cross-filtering, drill interactions, bookmarks, and report export.
